name: Days Gone
native_kbm_note: PS4/PS5 versions (incl. Remastered) have no keyboard/mouse gameplay support; KBM controls exist only in the PC port (PCGamingWiki Input section covers PC only; no source lists KBM on PlayStation).
notes: Mapping built from StrategyWiki's PS4/PC control table, cross-checked with magicgameworld's PC defaults (PS5 layout is the same as PS4). SPACE on PC is climb/mantle, roll and contextual action 2; mapped to CROSS (climb, contextual, shoulder swap while aiming), so roll (R1 on PS) is not reproduced. R on PC is reload (SQUARE) and also contextual action 1/craft (CIRCLE on PS); kept as reload. F on PC is listed as secondary interact (TRIANGLE) and flashlight (D-pad down) by different sources; mapped to flashlight. Weapon swap (TRIANGLE tap, hold for special) has no single PC key (PC uses 1-6 and mouse wheel); mouse wheel is mapped to TRIANGLE, which also covers secondary interactions. PC uses LCTRL or C for crouch. Menu tabs open with touchpad swipes on PS; the tool can only click the touchpad, so I/J/O/M are mapped to TOUCHPAD click (opens the menu, then change tabs with L1/R1). Bike: with this map W/S drive the left stick, so throttle and brake on the bike come from MOUSE1 (R2) and MOUSE2 (L2); nitro LALT -> CROSS; drift (PC SPACE, PS CIRCLE) and bike fire/lock-on (PS R1/L1) are not reproduced.
